subject: Formation of Charter Study Subcommittees
overview: The committee established subcommittees for specific charter sections, reviewed preliminary survey data, and organized outreach strategies for upcoming focus groups and public events.

items.title: Introductions and Minutes
items.summary: The committee welcomed new member Aubrey Webb and alternate David Zabner, then approved the minutes from the August 3, 2023 meeting.

items.title: Revised Work Plan and Subcommittee Structure
items.summary: The committee adopted a realistic work plan focused on forming nine subcommittees corresponding to specific charter articles, with a target presentation date of October 2024. Members discussed the potential inclusion of charter provisions regarding official conduct and residency requirements for city boards.

items.title: Interview Status and Municipal Research
items.summary: Members volunteered to interview former officials Patricia Brady Doherty and Paul Camuso, though the committee noted difficulties reaching current school and finance officials. The body agreed to conduct focused research into other municipalities, such as Everett and Lowell, regarding specific finance and representation models.

items.title: Focus Group and Outreach Planning
items.summary: The committee identified target demographics for upcoming focus groups, including youth, non-English speakers, and residents of affordable housing. Outreach efforts will emphasize reaching underrepresented groups to ensure a diverse range of feedback on charter issues.

items.title: Formation of School Committee Subcommittee
items.summary: The committee formed a School Committee Subcommittee, chaired by Paulette Van der Kloot, to research the size, composition, and ward representation of the body. The subcommittee was directed to investigate the mayor's role as chair or member and evaluate term lengths before reporting back in December.

items.title: Survey Results Analysis
items.summary: The committee reviewed 288 survey responses indicating majority support for keeping the mayor, increasing the mayoral term to four years, and moving toward hybrid ward representation. Discussion focused on the need to reach more renters and younger residents, with suggestions to distribute paper copies and conduct outreach at polling places on election day.

items.title: Charter Preamble and Upcoming Events
items.summary: The committee tabled the discussion on creating a charter preamble until the next meeting. Members also discussed presence at local events like Oktoberfest and assigned Milva McDonald and Danielle Balocca to plan the October 19th public meeting at City Hall.
